name: 3 John
description: Faithful welcome · shared support · disputed authority · personal testimony
limits: The elder has no assigned personal identity. Gaius and Demetrius are not identified with same-name people elsewhere. Historical authorship, dates, Greek forms, exact local setting, and the opposing party's own account were not independently verified.
review: All fourteen WEB verses read for an original explanation and exact selection. Three selected named profiles use newly inspected artwork and remain separate from same-name people elsewhere. The travelers have no invented route or destination. Competing USCCB readings remain attributed. Actual Church discussion remains separate.

sources.summary: The lesson connects joy with helping others walk in truth and warns against harmful conduct.
sources.limits: Third John coverage follows actual discussion of 1:1–4 and 9–11. Linked Restoration texts and reference entries were not independently reviewed.

reviewed.scope: Complete shared lesson body and resource list read. Only its actual Third John discussion supports this reference.

sources.title: Introduction to the Third Letter of John
sources.author: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
sources.publisher: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
sources.summary: The introduction offers several possible motives for Diotrephes' refusal.
sources.limits: These are competing interpretations rather than established motives. Historical authorship, exact local offices, audience conditions, and Demetrius' possible delivery role were not independently verified.

reviewed.scope: Complete three-paragraph introduction read through indexed source text. The guide attributes its range of possible motives and preserves uncertainty.

people.name: Gaius
people.role: Recipient praised for faithful welcome and help given to traveling believers
people.relations: The elder rejoices at reports about his conduct and asks him to continue his support.
people.meaning: His hospitality makes received truth visible through help for people beyond his familiar circle.

people.name: Diotrephes
people.role: Assembly member accused of rejecting the elder and excluding people who welcome the brothers
people.relations: The elder says he loves to be first and refuses the visiting brothers.
people.meaning: His conduct introduces a conflict over welcome and authority without preserving his own account.

people.name: Demetrius
people.role: Person recommended through testimony about his conduct
people.relations: The elder adds his own testimony to the good report from others.
people.meaning: His recommendation gives Gaius a positive example beside the warning about Diotrephes.

1.question: How does support for visiting believers make a host a fellow worker for truth?
1.teaching: The selected Church lesson connects joy with helping others walk in truth.
